description: This file contains the implementation of a generic data service class in C# for fetching lookup data from an API in a Blazor application. It defines the CatalogLookupDataService class, which interacts with HTTP endpoints to retrieve lists of lookup data objects, using dependency injection and generics.

classes.name: CatalogLookupDataService
classes.description: A generic service class for retrieving lookup data asynchronously via HTTP for Blazor applications. Implements ICatalogLookupDataService for specific LookupData types.

methods.name: CatalogLookupDataService
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the HttpClient, logger, and base API URL based on configuration.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches and returns a list of lookup data objects from a specified API endpoint.
